method: Each expected value is derived in Python from the workbook's input cells (chosen amounts, quotes, paid flags, categories, quotes/insured/reviews, utility dates, deposits, address rows) and compared with the value Microsoft Excel calculated. No expectation is read from the output cell it is compared to.

checks.check: Budget: total chosen = sum of Chosen column
Budget: paid = sum of Chosen where Paid = Y
Budget: still to pay = total - paid
Budget: share paid = paid / total

Budget: rollup 'Other'
Budget: variance = Chosen - MIN(Quote A, Quote B) on every quoted row
Budget: variance is blank when Chosen is blank
MoverCompare: deposit due = quote x deposit %
MoverCompare: price score, insured, reviews and total recompute exactly
MoverCompare: price score is capped at 0 (never negative)
MoverCompare: exactly the top-scoring mover is shortlisted
Summary: movers shortlisted
Summary: best mover score
Utilities: gap days = new start - old close
Utilities: electricity example shows a 2-day gap
Utilities: internet example shows a same-day handover (0)
Utilities: blank dates leave the gap blank

Summary: utilities with a break
Utilities: example dates render as real dates (not serial numbers)
